Structural.description: Part-whole, classification, containment and decomposition relationships. Used for hierarchical navigation and ontology-style inheritance or composition reasoning.
Structural.graphUse: Use for DAG views, capability decomposition, C4 containment, and metamodel hierarchy.

Behavioural.description: Operational interactions, functional use, production, consumption and runtime dependency relationships.
Behavioural.graphUse: Use for technical dependency, application/data flow, pipeline and execution-oriented traversal.

Causal.description: Relationships that express cause, consequence, influence, degradation, improvement, mitigation, failure propagation or risk propagation.
Causal.graphUse: Use for incident, risk, SLO, customer outcome, control, model drift, remediation and operational consequence reasoning.

Temporal.description: Relationships that express sequence, ordering, triggering, lifecycle progression, versioning, release timing, expiry or replacement over time.
Temporal.graphUse: Use for pipelines, releases, lifecycle activities, model versions, controls, policy validity and event-driven execution paths.

Governance.description: Policy, accountability, ownership, standard, control and audit relationships.
Governance.graphUse: Use for policy-to-control-to-risk, ownership, stewardship, audit and regulatory views.

Semantic.description: Meaning, equivalence, derivation, representation, realisation and conceptual alignment relationships.
Semantic.graphUse: Use for semantic enrichment, metamodel alignment, ontology export and GraphRAG neighbour expansion.

Causal: What downstream operational, customer or regulatory consequences could this event trigger?
Which risks increase if this service degrades?
Which controls or mitigation actions reduce the impact of this failure?
What root causes could lead to this incident?
Temporal: What events, approvals, deployments or releases happen before or after this change?
Which policy or control versions are effective at a given point in time?
What lifecycle activities follow this incident?
What sequence leads from discovery to deployment and monitoring?
